definition: DASS is the desired live autonomous-system state. Its measured production surface is the system directly participating in the governed autonomous objective: autonomous decisioning, authorized action, continuous service/liveness, safety/authority enforcement, verification, recovery, and evidence.
non_dass_rule: Anything outside active_roots is not DASS runtime surface unless explicitly promoted by this manifest. Quarantined legacy/income material is retained for history but is not an autonomous production dependency.
live_state_rule: Structural achievement alone is never DASS. DASS requires a current, successful governed supervisor cycle with an unexpired runtime liveness attestation. A stale state file, source-only measurement, converged-without-execution interpretation, or external-host requirement cannot establish DASS.
